prompt:
IMAGE TO VIDEO REQUEST: ONE SHORT ANIMATION CLIP.

WHAT THIS IS
A 2D sprite animation of the exact character in the attached first-frame image, preserving her exact face, proportions, hair, outfit, accessories, and hand-drawn colored pencil and ink caricature style throughout every frame.

CAMERA AND BACKGROUND
Locked static camera with zero movement. The character stays facing left with her feet planted on the exact same spot on a flat, solid pure magenta background with no shadows, lighting changes, or visual effects. Silent clip.

MOTION: SQUISHY CRUNCH
From her starting relaxed stance, she brings a small clear cube-shaped squishy toy out from behind her back, holds it out forward in one hand at chest height, and crushes it in her fist once. Without repeating the crush, she tucks the toy behind her back again. She returns to her starting relaxed stance and remains completely still in that pose for the rest of the clip.
kept: all words in every part of the current prompt
changed: nothing because the note about feet sinking and size changing cannot be carried without breaking the locked static camera feet planted rule and the rule to change only what the note names while copying every other word exactly
unused: feet sink into ground, size cahnges because using it would require changing the picture itself description or the locked camera and feet planted rules which the instructions forbid
why: nothing changed, so the note was not carried
note: feet sink into ground, size cahnges
